title: Undertale: The Last Corridor
alt: A long hall of gold with three tall pointed windows. In each window is a ring with two wings over three triangles. The floor is squares of two oranges, and each window lays a bright shape on it. In the middle stands a short skeleton with a wide grin, a blue jacket with a pale hood, black shorts and pink slippers. A blue fire burns in his left eye. Over him at the left and right float two great white skulls with horns, glowing eyes and jaws that open to the sides. The left one fires a wide beam of white light down across the floor. A small red heart is in the air beside the beam. Rows of white bones, a few of them blue, come up along the bottom edge. A yellow star shines at the far left, and a black pillar stands close to us at each side.
summary: A painting of Sans and his Gaster Blasters in the last corridor of Undertale in {strokes} brush strokes, with a playback of each stroke.
text: This is the last corridor, in Undertale, the game by Toby Fox. A human child has fallen into the land of the monsters, under a mountain. In this game you can end every fight without a blow. You are a small red heart, and you keep it away from what the monsters throw.

At the end waits Sans, a short skeleton who jokes and sleeps at his post. In this hall of gold he judges what you did. If you killed everyone, he fights, with rows of bones and with great skulls that fire light. The painting has {strokes} brush strokes.
